shots.zh: AI 已经不只是聊天。
shots.en: AI is no longer just a chat box.

shots.zh: 它读取业务数据、判断风险、调用工具，甚至直接修改业务系统。
shots.en: It reads your business data, assesses risk, calls tools — and writes into your systems.

shots.zh: 但当 AI 真正开始行动，企业缺的，可能不是更聪明的 Agent。
shots.en: But once AI starts acting, what's missing may not be a smarter agent.

shots.zh: 而是一层信任：它能碰不该碰的数据吗？会不经批准就写入吗？出了错，我们查得清、撤得回吗？
shots.en: It's trust: can it reach data it shouldn't? Write without approval? When something goes wrong, can we trace it — and undo it?

shots.zh: KeelBase 给出的答案，是一个开源的业务安全 AI 运行时。
shots.en: KeelBase answers with an open-source, business-safe AI runtime.

shots.zh: 上面是 AI 代理，下面是你的业务系统——CRM、ERP、OA。KeelBase 的治理层在中间，守住每一道边界。
shots.en: Agents on top. Your systems below — CRM, ERP, OA. KeelBase's governance layer sits between them, guarding every boundary.

shots.zh: 身份、策略、权限、人工确认、审计、撤销——每一步都有规则，每一次都有记录。
shots.en: Identity, policy, permission, human confirmation, audit, revocation — rules for every step, a record for every action.

shots.zh: 一句话：AI 可以行动，但只在明确的业务边界内。
shots.en: In one line: AI can act — but only within explicit business boundaries.

shots.zh: 我们来跑一遍真实流程。
shots.en: Let's run the real flow.

shots.zh: 问 AI：哪些客户本周最值得跟进？它会真的去读订单和跟进记录。
shots.en: Ask which customers deserve attention this week — and it actually reads orders and activity history.

shots.zh: 瀚宇制造，逾期两百八十万，风险最高，建议立即跟进。
shots.en: HanYu Manufacturing — 2.8 million overdue, highest risk, worth an immediate call.

shots.zh: 接着，AI 想建一个跟进任务。写入是真实的业务副作用，所以它先停下来问。
shots.en: Now the AI wants to create a follow-up task. Writing is a real business side effect, so it stops and asks first.

shots.zh: 确认卡不只说「要做什么」，还会告诉你这次动作会影响什么、能不能撤销。
shots.en: The confirmation card doesn't just say what it will do — it shows what the action affects, and how it can be revoked.

shots.zh: 你批准，它才执行。
shots.en: Only after you approve does it act.

shots.zh: 权限检查、人工批准、写入——三步都留下记录。
shots.en: Permission checked, approval received, record written — all three leave a trace.

shots.zh: CRM 里已经多了一条真实任务。这不是模拟出来的回答。
shots.en: A real task now exists in the CRM. This is not a simulated answer.

shots.zh: 这条链完整可查：谁发起、AI 怎么决策、调了哪个工具、为什么被允许、谁批准、最后改了什么。
shots.en: The chain is fully traceable: who asked, how the AI decided, which tool it called, why it was allowed, who approved, what changed.

shots.zh: 整条记录进入防篡改的审计链，并且可以离线校验。
shots.en: It all lands in a tamper-evident audit chain — verifiable offline.

shots.zh: 如果这次动作写了好几张表，撤销不必一条一条点——同一次业务动作的整组写入，会一起补偿。
shots.en: If one action wrote to several tables, revocation isn't click-by-click — the whole write group is compensated together.

shots.zh: 一次撤销，整组回滚。
shots.en: One revoke, the whole group rolls back.

shots.zh: 读取、决策、确认、执行、审计、撤销——这是一个闭环。
shots.en: Read, decide, confirm, act, audit, revoke — a closed loop.

shots.zh: 这套治理层不绑定某一家 Agent：MCP、OpenAPI、Function Calling，接进来就受同一套规则管。
shots.en: The governance layer isn't tied to one agent. MCP, OpenAPI, function calling — whatever you connect obeys the same rules.

shots.zh: 这不是又一个 Agent 框架，而是一个业务安全的 AI 运行时。
shots.en: This is not another agent framework. It is a business-safe AI runtime.

shots.zh: 那如果 AI 越过了自己的数据范围呢？
shots.en: What if the AI overreaches beyond its own data scope?

shots.zh: 运行时直接拒绝。依据、策略、范围，全部落在审计里——被拒绝不是异常，而是系统正常工作。
shots.en: The runtime denies it outright. Reason, policy and scope all land in the audit — a denial here is the system working, not failing.

shots.zh: 这些边界不是宣传语。管理台里可以现场跑对抗场景，直接看结果和决策轨迹。
shots.en: These boundaries are not marketing. The console runs adversarial scenarios on the spot and shows the outcome and the decision trace.

shots.zh: 安全边界不是靠提示词哄出来的，是运行时强制出来的。
shots.en: Security boundaries are not prompt instructions. They are enforced at runtime.

shots.zh: 要建新业务模块？从一句业务诉求开始，先变成结构化的业务规格。
shots.en: Need a new business module? Start from one business request, mapped into a structured business spec.

shots.zh: 再确定性映射成模块协议——一条命令，生成真实的业务源码。
shots.en: Then deterministically mapped into a module protocol — one command, and real business source code comes out.

shots.zh: 生成的是普通源码：看得懂、改得动，留在你自己的仓库里。
shots.en: What you get is ordinary source code — readable, editable, in your own repository.

shots.zh: 存量系统也不用推倒重来。把接口交给 KeelBase，它们就变成受治理的 AI 工具。
shots.en: Existing systems don't need a rewrite. Hand their APIs to KeelBase and they become governed AI tools.

shots.zh: 读操作自动执行，写操作必须批准——核心代码一行不改。
shots.en: Reads run automatically, writes require approval — without changing a single line of core code.

shots.zh: 数据敏感，就私有化部署：本地模型、本地向量化、本地审计，数据一步不出域。
shots.en: Sensitive data? Deploy privately: local model, local embeddings, local audit — data never leaves your domain.

shots.zh: Docker、离线、本地部署——数据主权，握在自己手里。
shots.en: Docker, offline, on-premise — data sovereignty stays in your own hands.

shots.zh: 每一次业务动作，都能导出成一份自包含的 HTML 证据报告；审计方离线就能复核，不必安装 KeelBase。
shots.en: Every business action exports to a self-contained HTML evidence report — auditors verify it offline, without installing KeelBase.

shots.zh: 第一次打开就有就绪清单：运行时、数据库、AI、治理、演示——每一维都告诉你下一步该做什么。
shots.en: From the first launch, a readiness list shows where you stand — runtime, database, AI, governance, demo — each with its own next step.

shots.zh: 构建、运行、信任、私有部署。KeelBase：AI 可以行动，但只在明确的业务边界内。
shots.en: Build, run, trust, private deploy. KeelBase: AI can act — but only within explicit business boundaries.
